title: The Drowned Customhouse
summary: Dock syndicates and river boatmen in Lilmoth Harbour discover that smugglers are disturbing the silver Kothringi quarantine shrines and moving crimson-sealed cargo through the drowned customhouse hulks.

hook.rumour: The silver warning-bells on the old Kothringi quarantine posts outside Lilmoth Harbour rang by themselves at low tide, and three smuggling punts washed ashore without their crews.
hook.notice: LILMOTH HARBOUR CUSTOMHOUSE: River-pilots and wardens sought to inspect the drowned customhouse hulks and reseal the Kothringi quarantine shrines.

npcs.name: Warden of Lilmoth
npcs.greet: The silver warning-bells on the old Kothringi quarantine posts outside Lilmoth Harbour rang by themselves at low tide, and three smuggling punts washed ashore without their crews.
talk: The trouble across Lilmoth began when sealed dispatches started bypassing Lilmoth.
If you mean to help the Lilmoth Harbour Syndicates, start by checking the trail between Lilmoth and Sap Shell Ruins.

npcs.name: Chronicler of Lilmoth
npcs.greet: Keep your voice low—everyone at Sap Shell Ruins is watching who asks after the old seals.
talk: We traced the couriers from Sap Shell Ruins toward Still Heart Kwama Mine before they vanished into the brush.
Bring any ciphered tallies back to Lilmoth so Harbour-Speaker Jeetum can see the proof.

npcs.name: Outrider of Still Heart Kwama Mine
npcs.greet: You made good time from Sap Shell Ruins. The saboteurs have fortified the approaches near Hist Wallow Grotto.
talk: Their ringleader is holding the inner chamber at Hist Wallow Grotto with a picked guard.
Once Hist Wallow Grotto is cleared, return to Lilmoth to seal the regional compact.

npcs.name: Speaker of Lilmoth
npcs.greet: Harbour-Speaker Jeetum awaits word on whether the crisis in Lilmoth has been contained.
talk: The elders of Lilmoth have prepared the concord table for your return.
All of Lilmoth owes you a debt for standing between Lilmoth and ruin.
